newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates unaffected by Bhutto's ouster.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates unaffected by Bhutto's ouster.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates closed lower on Tuesday amid an excess of funds and dealers said rates were likely to remain steady to weak on Wednesday.
They said the inter-bank market had been relatively unaffected by President Farooq Leghari's abrupt dismissal in the early hours of Benazir Bhutto's three-year-old government.

Overnight funds opened at 14 percent and closed at 13 percent, one dealer said. Heavy amounts changed hands in the range of 10 and 13 percent. Dealers said rates were expected to stay steady on Wednesday in the absence of big flows in or out.
